trust_decision.summary: A combined-resource ID is trusted only when every resource identifier it decodes to names a .css/.js resource and its decompressed form stays within 64 KiB; the decision is taken in CombinedResourceInfo.get through a new isCombinable over the decoded identifiers, and in Utils.unserializeURLSafe for the decode bound, while server-side builder-created IDs stay trusted.

landing_point.why: The summary names forged combined-resource IDs; this class owns ID decoding (fromUniqueId, :287-306) and the acceptance/caching decision (:139-141), and it is the first place the reported symptom is visible.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Utils.unserializeURLSafe is a generic URL-safe codec used for arbitrary strings, not a resource handler; the report is about forged combined-resource IDs, so an engineer can argue the inflate bound and the public codec are outside the fix and only guard CombinedResourceInfo.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Server-side combinations built from real component resources must keep being created and cached even when a legitimate stylesheet/script name does not end in .css/.js (e.g. RichFaces skinning.ecss, cited at CombinedResourceHandler.java:139). The fix therefore restructures Builder.create to insert into CACHE directly instead of going through get(); an over-broad fix that only adds isCombinable inside get() makes Builder.create() return null and throw NullPointerException at .id for such pages.

O6_input_shapes: single resource identifier without library: style.css -> accepted
library-qualified identifier: library:script.js -> accepted (ResourceIdentifier splits on ':')
pipe-joined set: style.css|page.xhtml -> whole ID rejected when any member is not .css/.js
case variants: .CSS / .JS accepted (name.toLowerCase() before the suffix test)
malformed base64/zlib ID -> IllegalArgumentException caught in fromUniqueId -> null (pre-existing, :293-296)
over-large decompression: a small deflate that inflates past 64 KiB is rejected by Utils.unserializeURLSafe

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A cache-hit / builder-produced-entry variant of the same identity check (validate CombinedResourceInfo instances when they are served, not only when created by get()).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Builder.create writes IDs straight into CACHE without isCombinable, so the cache-hit branch returns a combination the check never saw; a maintainer tightening ID trust would naturally re-check on retrieval.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The same .css/.js identity allowlist applied to the request-derived resourceName and ln before they are forwarded into the resource handler chain.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is the second documented front door for resource requests and already forwards arbitrary request names into createResource.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An extension/identity check before the library:* wildcard mapping appends an arbitrary resource name to a configured CDN URL.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The handler already maps arbitrary resource names against configuration and explicitly supports a wildcard case.

O9_family: Insufficient verification of data authenticity (CWE-345) letting attacker-chosen resource identifiers reach resource resolution and output (CWE-79) plus uncontrolled resource consumption (CWE-770) through unbounded inflation and cache growth; CWE-862/missing authorization appears only in the 2.x push commits, which have no code at the pinned commit.
